description: This PHP script is responsible for generating and saving a vCard for a contact in the SuiteCRM system. It loads necessary dependencies, retrieves language settings, initializes a vCard object, loads contact data based on request parameters, and then saves the vCard.

classes.name: vCard
classes.description: A class responsible for managing vCard creation, loading contact data, and saving the vCard.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact information into the vCard object based on contact ID and module.

methods.name: saveVCard
methods.description: Saves the constructed vCard to storage or output.
